trigger: D3-v23 Java report reads timed out while the authoritative Python run was already completed.
observations: Thread capture showed task reads extracting H2 CLOB payloads and an upstream research read awaiting a response; no database deadlock is asserted.
Saved D3 workspace lists contained about 0.8 MB messages and 1.8 MB artifacts before JSON formatting.
The service discarded current projections returned by publication/revision transactions and re-read the entire task again.
change: Reuse the latest locked projection returned by publication/revision updates in the response.
Remove the unused initial workspace load inside publishV2.
Use a single task snapshot for material membership and run lookup in scopeCheck.
Remove an extra ownership read in syncPublication because getV2 still performs the ownership check.

validation.jdk: Cached Maven 3.9.6 / Temurin 21.0.3 container, network disabled, source/dependency cache read-only, independent build output and in-memory test database
validation.initialHostBuild: JDK25 compile failed before tests with javac TypeTag UNKNOWN. No dependency upgrade or business database mutation was used to work around it.

limitations: Reduced redundant reads are tested; runtime latency improvement is not yet measured.
This change does not introduce pagination or normalize the existing task JSON storage.
